physics-killer-02.title: Ish va mexanik energiyaning oʻzaro aylanishi
physics-killer-02.topic: Ish va mexanik energiyaning oʻzaro aylanishi
physics-killer-02.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-02.material: Ishqalanishsiz relsning pastki qismidan (balandlik $0$) radiusi $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$ bo'lgan vertikal doiraviy halqa (loop) ulangan. Massasi $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ bo'lgan jism relsda tinch holatda qo'yib yuborilib, halqani bir marta aylanib o'tishi kerak. $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ bo'lganda, halqaning eng yuqori nuqtasida relsdan uzilmay o'tish uchun minimal boshlang'ich balandlik $h_{min}$ (pastki nuqtadan hisoblanganda) va boshlang'ich balandlik $15\,\mathrm{m}$ bo'lganda eng yuqori nuqtada rels jismga ta'sir qiladigan normal reaksiya kuchi $N$ tartib bilan to'g'ri juftlangan javob qaysi?
physics-killer-02.thinking.0: Ish va mexanik energiyaning oʻzaro aylanishi
physics-killer-02.s.s1.prompt: Ishqalanishsiz relsning pastki qismidan (balandlik $0$) radiusi $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$ bo'lgan vertikal doiraviy halqa (loop) ulangan. Massasi $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ bo'lgan jism relsda tinch holatda qo'yib yuborilib, halqani bir marta aylanib o'tishi kerak. $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ bo'lganda, halqaning eng yuqori nuqtasida relsdan uzilmay o'tish uchun minimal boshlang'ich balandlik $h_{min}$ (pastki nuqtadan hisoblanganda) va boshlang'ich balandlik $15\,\mathrm{m}$ bo'lganda eng yuqori nuqtada rels jismga ta'sir qiladigan normal reaksiya kuchi $N$ tartib bilan to'g'ri juftlangan javob qaysi?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.explain: Minimal shart $N=0$: $mg=mv^2/R\Rightarrow v_{top}^2=gR=40$. Energiyaning saqlanishi $mgh_{min}=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$ dan $h_{min}=2R+\dfrac{R}{2}=2.5R=10\,\mathrm{m}$. $h=15\,\mathrm{m}$ bo'lganda $v_{top}^2=2g(h-2R)=2\cdot10\cdot7=140$. $mg+N=mv^2/R$ dan $N=m\left(\dfrac{v^2}{R}-g\right)=2(35-10)=50\,\mathrm{N}$. Faqat $2R=8\,\mathrm{m}$ balandlikni ishlatsa kinetik energiya tushirib qoldirilgan bo'ladi (noto'g'ri javob ①), $N=mv^2/R=70\,\mathrm{N}$ og'irlik kuchi e'tiborga olinmagan (noto'g'ri javob ②), $90\,\mathrm{N}$ esa og'irlik kuchi qo'shilgan ishora xatosi (noto'g'ri javob ③).
physics-killer-02.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-02.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
physics-killer-02.s.s1.hint.0: Eng yuqori nuqtada $mg+N=\dfrac{mv^2}{R}$, uzilmaslik sharti $N\ge0$, ya'ni $v_{top}\ge\sqrt{gR}$. Energiyaning saqlanishidan $mgh=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$.
